text:
Maya (infra): Heads up — we need to decide region placement for Q3 reserved GPU commits. Can folks drop quick region-by-region cost + operational notes (SKUs, network, limits)? I'll synthesize.

Kevin (finance): Quick summary from billing probe: one-year reserved-like commitments show effective savings roughly: us-west ~20–25% vs on-demand, europe ~15–20% (higher infra tax/energy pass-through), apac ~8–15% (less aggressive discounts right now). I can push exact amortized $/GPU-month later.

Jon (eng-infra): Ops note: APAC regions (asia-southeast1, asia-northeast1) are missing latest A100v4/large partitions for sustained capacity — quota and SKU availability are the blocker, not just price. Also inter-region private links in EU cost more per GiB (we saw peer-link charges pop up).

Priya (sre): Network caution: egress and cross-region replication for cache warmups adds tail latency. If we route EU traffic to US-hosted models we pay egress + see 60–120ms tail growth for some endpoints. We should quantify egress $/month on projected QPS.

Sara (eng-ml): From model perf: cold KV cache across regions is real — 2x token latency on first few requests after failover. For low-latency apps it's better to colocate model + user region even if cost is +10–15%. Also, embeddings-heavy workloads amplify egress costs.

Kevin (finance): Proposal idea: hybrid commit profile — front-load reserved capacity in us-west (largest demand, best discounts) + modest reserved in europe-west4 for enterprise/regulated customers. Keep APAC mostly on-demand + spot until we can secure annual SKUs or partner colo. Rough placeholder numbers: A100-class reserved ~ $1.8k–2.4k / GPU-month amortized depending on term and provider; on-demand ~ +20–30% higher. (I'll export exact per-region parity table by EOD).

Jon (eng-infra): Implementation gotchas: some clouds' committed use discounts are global billing credits (good), others require regional reserved instances (harder to move). Also check preemptible/spot blend — we can shift non-latency workloads to spot, but serving pools must be backed by guaranteed capacity.

Priya (sre): Actionable network test: I'll run a synthetic KV miss/replication probe to measure extra egress and tail latency across US/EU/APAC. Will post numbers in the thread when done.

capacity-bot: capacity-bot queued run: region-scan:1790125460 — inventory and quota snapshot started (ETA ~2h) :gear:

Jon (eng-infra): Quick routing note: if we choose split (US + EU reserved), we need per-route policy in the control plane to prefer local pool for EU customers and fallback to global on overload. That also affects billing attribution (make sure cost center tagging persists).

Kevin (finance): One more finance item: vendors will give better APAC pricing if we commit 12+ months or do a cross-region SKU bundling. That requires legal + CFO sign-off. Could be worth it if roadmap shows 40%+ APAC growth.

Maya (infra): OK — action items I took: 1) @Kevin produce per-region per-GPU effective cost table (1yr & 3yr amortized) by EOD; 2) @Jon check SKU availability/quota & list risky regions; 3) @Priya run the network egress/latency probe and post results; 4) @Sara give perf delta table for cold vs warm cache across regions. I'll compile a recommendation doc for leadership. :thumbsup:

Kevin (finance): On it — will include a small sensitivity sheet (demand +/-20%).

Priya (sre): Running probes now, will ping when finished.

Maya (infra): Thanks — please keep replies short here; I'll post the synthesized decision thread later. :eyes:
